arguments.sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_count, COUNT(*) AS labelled_count FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
arguments.explanation: Returns the fraud rate across all labelled transactions, as a fraction, along with the fraud count and the number of labelled transactions it is based on.
assumptions: The rate is computed over labelled transactions only (777,339 of 1,159,966). The roughly 33% with no fraud label are excluded, not counted as legitimate.
The rate is returned as a fraction between 0 and 1, not multiplied by 100.
The period covered is the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
